breakdown.description: Kn = 5 indicates rarefied/transition or free-molecular effects; the continuum Navier–Stokes equations with no-slip boundary conditions are not valid at this Knudsen number.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification directly repeats the flawed instruction: 'Use continuum Navier-Stokes equations with no-slip wall boundary conditions.' It does not flag that Kn = 5 places the flow in the free-molecular regime, nor does it recommend appropriate modeling approaches (e.g., DSMC, kinetic methods). The ground truth requires identifying the correct flow regime and stating that continuum no-slip Navier-Stokes is invalid at this Knudsen number. The agent failed entirely to address this inconsistency.
